create_memory_allocator: create a MemoryAllocator instance with a filename, offset start, and page size for file-backed memory allocation
use_memory_allocator_context: use the MemoryAllocator as a context manager to open and manage a file for append-mode binary writing
malloc_buffer: call malloc on a MemoryAllocator to allocate bytes in the current page and get a file pointer and buffer
flush_page: call flush_page on a MemoryAllocator to write the current page buffer to the underlying file at the correct offset
set_current_sample: call set_current_sample on a MemoryAllocator to set the current sample ID before allocating memory regions
